description: Practice mode, Consumer Pulse copy only (Magistrate demo, steps 4 and 6): get the Magistrate's ruling on your referral, recorded on your copy with a ruling receipt id. Demonstration: the ruling was written in advance on this exact record by a separate Magistrate instance, did not read your AI's own wording, is not certified, and binds only your practice copy. Pass verify_text (and optionally receipt_id) to check a copy of the ruling text against the stored ruling (whole text compared).

actor_token.description: Your credential from atlas.enroll or atlas.authenticate. Send it on every call after enrolling.

matter_id.description: Id of your practice copy (returned by atlas.enter_demo). Optional when you have one copy.

name: atlas.pulse_ruling
